title: Centering mathematical contract erases integer division state
analysis: For integer display C and integer screen dimensions W/H, screen-center offsets B=(2(W-32),2(H-32)) are integers. The reference center quotient is floor((C+B)/128) per integer-valued axis, whereas floating display uses real division. Requested endpoint is C+128*(target-quotient), before SnapEdges. No full Data/Scripts textual class/def/alias/define_method scan found an Integer/Fixnum/Numeric division override. Numeric utility only adds formatting. Setup naturally writes integer0; regular player center with integer tile coordinates writes integer displays. Fractional-distance scroll/intermediate interpolation can write float displays, so neither type can be assumed from the number0 alone.

counterexample.premises: Valid30x20 map,512x384 screen,SnapEdges=false,no old scroll/no competing camera write/no map switch, stationary player and normal updates; integer display(0,0), target(10,8), independent speed0 and speed4 examples.
counterexample.integer_result: Center quotient(7,5), offsets(3,3), endpoint(384,384). speed0 immediately assigns; speed4 each axis duration.6s, at.5s both320 but scrolling remains true, at.6s both384 and done.
counterexample.float_contrast: Floating display(0.0,0.0) gives quotients(7.5,5.5), offsets(2.5,2.5), endpoint(320.0,320.0), duration.5s. Mixed integer0/floating0.0 yields endpoint(384,320), durations.6/.5s.
counterexample.edge_contrast: CAM13 target(0,0), integer0 start requests(-896,-640), floating0.0 requests(-960,-704); SnapEdges=true clips both to(0,0), so its clipped outcome remains supported but its universal unclipped target is wrong.
counterexample.negative_contrast: Integer start(-961,-705), target(0,0), SnapEdges=false gives summed center offsets(-1,-1), integer quotients(-1,-1), distance(1,1), endpoint(-833,-577), speed4.2s. Floating same-valued inputs instead yield ideal(-960,-704), demonstrating floor rather than truncation toward zero.

impact: Independent implementation using the candidate formula changes endpoint by64 subpixels per axis and waiting completion by.1s in the provided integer fixture; it also erases mixed-axis behavior and negative integer quantization.
minimum_revision: Qualify continuous formula with floating division premise; describe integer-axis quantization independently of implementation architecture, make initial numeric-state premises explicit, split CAM12 into integer/float cases, and qualify CAM13's unclipped target. Preserve correct validation order/SnapEdges clipping/no-runtime limits; do not patch reference.
acceptance: Static reread must derive integer(384,384)/.6s, float(320,320)/.5s and mixed-axis contrast from revised prose; edge integer/float requests differ but both clip0, negative integer quotient uses floor. All remain NOT_EXECUTED.

title: Shop consumer wording overgeneralizes sale entry scroll
analysis: Shared buy/sell scene calls right5/speed5 before opening. Buy enters it directly; sale uses bag subscene when bag exists and only uses shared scene otherwise. Bag sale-entry body has no call to camera wrapper, and its exit also suppresses left5. Candidate only names subscene exit exception, while stating buy/sell entries both scroll. CAM14's no-subscene fixture is supportable and should remain narrowly bound.

counterexample.premises: Valid normal scene with bag present, no old scroll, no competing camera write; invoke normal sale entry via pbStartSellScene.
counterexample.reference_result: Branches into bag-sale subscene: no new right5 camera task; subsequent subscene exit has no left5 task.
counterexample.candidate_result: Prose implies sale entry right5/speed5/.5s waiting.

impact: Reader may introduce an extra camera move/wait for bag sale consumer.
minimum_revision: Bind right/left5 contract to shared buy/sell screen (buy and non-bag sale), and state bag sale branch skips entry as well as exit scrolling. Clarify CAM14 no-subscene premise; retain existing supported.5s vectors. No broad M10 review required.
acceptance: Revised wording statically distinguishes buy/shared sale right+left5 from bag sale neither camera task; all scenes/rendering remain unexecuted.

title: 空起点首次失败被统一写成已消费后续随机抽样
claimed: WP14为生成失败含空可访问起点列出‘全局随机已重播及部分消费’；DQ06将antiring2×2空起点和密度0失败合并断言‘重播和消费随机’。
actual_static_boundary: 清待播种子与重播已经确定；antiring2×2在空可访问集合sample返回空值后首次读取起点坐标失败，方向shuffle及后续抽样未到。固定R不含Array#sample原生内部实现，不能从调用名断言序列正向推进；应保留具体路径实际已经发生的抽样前缀。

supplemental_primary_evidence.summary: len<2分支先选择索引0，随机取索引仅在另一分支。
同样在len<2分支绕过随机取索引。

primary_evidence_limit: 官方实现定点只读补核不代替固定R宿主身份；精确宿主Ruby版本UNVERIFIED，不构成运行结论。
impact: 实现者或测试设计可能人为推进一个不存在或未证的随机抽样步骤，随后其它全局随机消费者序列发生差异；将清seed误作正抽样消费也使失败前缀失真。

minimum_counterexample.premises: 当前有效A；B未驻留、可读取、地牢标记真；无插件/其它写入；标准有效参数2×2节点、10×10单元、NodeLayout=antiring、待播S存在、参数固定seed为空；旧暂存(u,v)；查询B地形。
minimum_counterexample.static_result: S清空、以S重播；空集合起点读取失败；后续方向/房间/装饰/图块化/摆放未到，B原宽高/数据未改，旧暂存保留；不能统一承诺已抽取消耗一个随机数。

minimum_revision: 只收窄WP14 L43和DQ06 L448为‘已清待播种子并重播全局随机；后续随机消费按具体首次失败点保留实际已发生前缀’，或分开空起点与装饰密度0路径。不得反向无条件声称固定宿主零消费。
acceptance: 复读这两处确保清seed/重播与抽样消费分开，空起点不承诺正抽样推进，其它原图未写/旧暂存/未驻留前缀保持；无需执行案例、运行Ruby或改参考。
history_scope: 旧C044只规定seed已消费/原图未写，保留其CLOSED_QUALIFIED_ORIGINAL_SCOPE；本问题仅本轮新增措辞，不重开旧控制。
